faqs.question: What is “GullyFame India” and how does it work?
faqs.answer: “GullyFame India” is a mobile‑based platform that enables users to upload, view, share, and interact with user‑generated content (including short videos, images, text‑posts, and comments). The App is governed by the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 and other applicable Indian laws. Use of the App constitutes full acceptance of these Terms of Use, our Privacy Policy and our Community Guidelines.

faqs.question: Who can use this App?
faqs.answer: The App is intended for Indian residents who are at least 18 years of age or possess full legal capacity under law. The Company reserves the right to request proof of age at any time and shall not be liable for misrepresentation of age or identity.

faqs.question: What is required to register on GullyFame India?
faqs.answer: To register, you must provide a valid mobile number or email address, create a secure password, and complete any required verification steps (such as OTP‑based authentication). You warrant that all information provided is true, accurate, current, and complete. Fictitious, automated, or fraudulent registrations will result in immediate suspension or permanent deactivation of the account..

faqs.question: What are my legal responsibilities as a user?
faqs.answer:
As a user, you agree to use the App solely for lawful purposes and in full compliance with Indian criminal, cyber, data protection, and intellectual property laws. You explicitly agree not to:
• Post, upload, or transmit any content that is defamatory, obscene, hateful, pornographic, violent, or illegal.
• Impersonate any person or entity or misrepresent your affiliation with any individual or organization.
• Use the App to propagate terrorism, child sexual abuse material (CSAM), self-harm, dangerous activities, or any other unlawful activity under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS), the Information Technology Act, 2000, and other applicable Indian statutes. Any violation will lead to immediate content removal, account suspension, and reporting to law enforcement authorities.

faqs.question: What are the rules regarding AI-Generated Content, Deepfakes, and Synthetic Media?
faqs.answer:
GullyFame India values authenticity and transparency:
• What is synthetic/AI-generated media and do I have to label it? Any content generated or modified using AI must be declared upon upload. Provide visual instructions on how users can apply the in-app AI tag or label before posting.
• Disclosure & Labelling: Any content created, modified, or enhanced using Artificial Intelligence (AI), deepfake technology, synthetic voice generation, or manipulated media must be clearly labelled and disclosed prior to publishing.
• Can I upload parodies, memes, or satirical deepfakes? Manipulating someone’s face or voice without consent to deceive, defame, or commit fraud is strictly illegal under Indian law.
• Prohibited Synthetic Content: Users are strictly prohibited from uploading AI-generated media designed to deceive, impersonate real individuals without consent, defame, spread misinformation, or create non-consensual explicit images.
• Enforcement: Unlabelled or harmful synthetic content will be removed immediately upon detection or reporting, and offending accounts may face permanent termination.
• How fast will infringing or defamatory deepfake content be removed? Non-consensual explicit content, severe identity theft, or government removal orders are reviewed immediately and can be taken down within a strict 3-hour window.
• How do I report an AI impersonation or deepfake of myself? There is a simple step-by-step reporting guide for using the in-app report button under “Impersonation / AI Deepfake”) which provides the Grievance Officer’s direct contact info.
• What happens if I receive a false takedown? There is an appeal process to escalate disputes to the Grievance Appellate Committee (GAC).

faqs.question: Are fake engagement, bot activities, or voting manipulation allowed?
faqs.answer:
No. GullyFame India strictly prohibits any form of artificial or manipulated engagement. Users, creators, and participants in platform competitions or leaderboards are prohibited from:
• Using bots, automated software, or third-party services to generate fake likes, views, shares, or comments.
• Creating multiple accounts to manipulate voting, contests, rankings, or rewards mechanisms.
• Participating in coordinated engagement schemes or vote-tampering. Any attempt to manipulate rankings or competition outcomes will result in immediate disqualification, forfeiture of rewards, and account termination.

faqs.question: Can the App be used for commercial, sponsored, or promotional activities?
faqs.answer:
Commercial activity is permitted strictly within platform guidelines:
• Sponsored Content & Disclosures: Creators and users posting sponsored posts, paid partnerships, affiliate links, or promotional material must clearly label such content and adhere to Indian consumer protection regulations and Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) guidelines.
• Prohibited Commercial Conduct: Unauthorized commercial solicitation, spam, phishing malware distribution, fake reviews, misleading claims or advertising prohibited goods/services is strictly banned.
• The Company reserves the right to block accounts or remove promotional content that violates these rules.

faqs.question: What are my Intellectual Property (IP) rights over the content I post?
faqs.answer:
• Creator Ownership: You retain full ownership and copyright of original content you create and upload to GullyFame India.
• Platform License: By uploading content, you grant GullyFame India a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, limited license to host, store, display, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, and distribute your content solely for the technical operation, improvement, and promotion of the App and its services.
• Commercial Third-Party Licensing: GullyFame India will have you grant GullyFame a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable and sublicensable licence, for the maximum period permitted by law, to host, store, reproduce, process, adapt, edit, translate, format, publicly perform, publicly display, distribute, communicate, promote and otherwise use Your Content as reasonably necessary to operate, secure, improve, market and develop the Platform and its services without your separate, explicit written consent.
• Warranties: You warrant that you own or possess all necessary rights, licenses, and permissions for all content (including background music, imagery, and personal likenesses) uploaded.

faqs.question: How is user-generated content regulated and moderated?
faqs.answer: GullyFame India operates as an intermediary under Indian Law. While we do not actively monitor every piece of content in real-time, we maintain robust automated and human moderation systems guided by our comprehensive Community Guidelines. We reserve the right to restrict, disable access to, or permanently remove any content that violates platform policies or statutory laws, and to report illegal acts to relevant authorities.

faqs.question: How is my personal data processed under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP)?
faqs.answer:
GullyFame India processes personal data in strict compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (and any rules framed thereunder).
• Data Collected: Device information, IP Addresses, location data, usage analytics, and user identifiers.
• Purposes: Platform service delivery, account verification, analytics, security and statutory compliance.
• User Rights: Users retain the right to access, update, correct, or request the deletion of their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time through App Settings, subject to operational and regulatory requirements. Detailed information is provided in our Privacy Policy/DPDP Notice.

faqs.question: How is my privacy and account security protected?
faqs.answer: The Company employs commercially reasonable technical and organisational measures to safeguard user data against unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. In addition, GullyFame maintains an internal Security Incident & Breach Response Framework to handle data incidents and satisfy regulatory notification mandates. Users are responsible for keeping login credentials confidential. Any suspected security breach or unauthorised account access should be reported immediately to the support team.

faqs.question: How can I report abusive, unlawful, or offensive content or IP Infringement on the App?
faqs.answer: Users can report objectionable content, harassment, copyright infringement, or privacy violations directly in-app using the “Report” button located on every piece of content or profile. Reports are promptly routed to our moderation team and Grievance Officer for review. The Company may take actions including content removal, account suspension, or escalation to law enforcement as deemed appropriate.

faqs.question: What is the Grievance‑Redressal Mechanism and response timeline?
faqs.answer: In compliance with the IT Act and the Intermediary Guidelines, 2021, the Company has appointed a Grievance Officer whose contact details are available on the App and the website. Users may lodge complaints regarding content, privacy, or any other grievance, and the Grievance Officer shall acknowledge the complaint within 24 hours and seek to resolve it within 72 hours.

faqs.question: How are Legal Disputes Resolved?
faqs.answer: These FAQs and any disputes arising out of the use of the App are governed by the laws of India. Courts at New Delhi shall have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to mandatory statutory consumer remedies or provisions of Indian law that cannot be contractually excluded.

faqs.question: Are there any disclaimers or limitations of liability?
faqs.answer: The App and its services are provided on an “as-is” and “as-available” basis. The Company disclaims all express or implied warranties to the fullest extent permitted by Indian law. Nothing in these Terms or FAQs purports to limit or exclude liabilities or consumer rights that cannot be legally excluded under statutory Indian laws.

faqs.question: Can the Company modify these FAQs or the App’s rules?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Company reserves the right to amend these FAQs, the Terms of Use, and the Privacy Policy at any time, by providing notice through the App or via registered email/mobile notification. Continued use of the App after such notice shall be deemed acceptance of the modified terms. Users are encouraged to review the FAQs and associated policies periodically.

1. INTRODUCTION
GullyFame India ("we," "us," "our," or the "Company") operates the GullyFame India mobile application and related services (collectively, the "Platform"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting personal data in accordance with applicable Indian law, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act"), the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025, to the extent applicable and in force, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable rules, and other applicable privacy, cybersecurity and intermediary requirements. This Privacy Policy ("Policy") explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how we use and share it, how long we retain it, the choices and rights available to you, and how you can contact us.

2. SCOPE
This Policy applies to personal data processed through the Platform, including the mobile application, websites, APIs, integrations, creator tools, competitions, payments, support channels and related services. Where a feature has a separate privacy notice or specific terms, that notice will apply together with this Policy.

3. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this Policy:
• "Personal Data" means data about an identifiable individual, as defined by applicable law.
• "Data Principal" means the individual to whom the personal data relates, where that term applies under the DPDP Act.
• "Consent" means a lawful, informed, specific and unambiguous indication of the individual’s wishes, where the consent is the applicable basis of processing.
• “User Content” means photos, videos, audio, text, comments, messages and other material submitted or shared through the Platform.

4. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We collect only information reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy and as permitted by applicable law.

4.1. Information You Provide
• Identity data: name, date of birth, gender and profile photograph.
• Contact data: mobile number, email address and, where required, address/city/state/PIN code.
• Account data: username, password and account-security information.
• User Content: photos, videos, audio, text posts, comments, messages and other content you upload or share.
• Communications: support requests, feedback, surveys and correspondence.
• Payment/KYC data: bank account details, IFSC, UPI ID, payment information and, where legally/operationally necessary, government identification such as PAN or other permitted KYC information.

4.2. Sensitive/High-Risk Information
Where the Platform uses biometric authentication or processes other information that is specially regulated or otherwise high-risk, we will provide the required notice and obtain consent or rely on another lawful basis where permitted. We will not collect such information merely because it is listed in a generic category; collection will depend on the feature you use.

4.3. Information Collected Automatically
We may collect device and technical information such as device model, operating-system version, app version, identifiers permitted by law, IP address, logs, crash reports, performance information, timestamps and security signals. We may collect approximately or precise location only where enabled by you, required for a feature, or otherwise permitted by law, if needed.

4.4. Information From Third Parties
We may receive information from connected accounts, payment providers, KYC providers, Fraud-prevention services, analytics providers, business partners and other lawful sources, subject to applicable law and the permissions or consents required.

5. PURPOSES OF PROCESSING
We may process personal data to: (a) create and manage accounts; (b) authenticate users and recover accounts; (c) provide, maintain and improve the Platform; (d) personalise feeds, recommendations and features; (e) enable creator tools, competitions, rewards, tipping, commerce and payouts; (f) process payments, refunds, KYC and tax-related requirements; (g) communicate service updates, security alerts and support responses; (h) send marketing or promotional communications where required with consent or another lawful basis; (i) detect fraud, spam, abuse, manipulation and security threats; (j) moderate and protect the Platform and its community; (k) analyse usage, troubleshoot and develop products; and (l) comply with applicable law, court orders and lawful government requests.

6. LAWFUL BASIS, NOTICE AND CONSENT
We process personal data on the basis permitted by applicable law, including consent where required, specified legitimate uses/lawful purposes where available, compliance with legal obligations, and other permitted grounds. Where consent is required, we will provide an appropriate notice and seek consent in a manner required by law.
You may withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. Withdrawal may affect features that require that processing, and we may continue processing where permitted or required by law, including for security, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, accounting, tax or legal compliance.

7. PERSONALISATION, ANALYTICS AND ADVERTISING
We may use technical, usage and preference information to understand how the Platform is used, improve products, measure performance, prevent abuse and personalise content or recommendations.
Where advertising is offered, we may use information to deliver contextual advertising and, where permitted, personalised advertising. We may work with advertising or measurement providers subject to applicable law and required permissions. We do not sell personal data in the ordinary course of business.

8. CREATOR CONTENT AND PLATFORM RIGHTS
You retain ownership of original content that you create and submit, subject to any separate agreement you enter into. By uploading or sharing User Content, you grant GullyFame the permissions reasonably necessary to host, store, reproduce, display, transmit, distribute, format, technically modify and make the content available through the Platform and to promote the Platform using your content, subject to the Terms of Use and applicable law. You grant GullyFame a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, transferable and sublicensable licence, for the maximum period permitted by law, to host, store, reproduce, process, adapt, edit, translate, format, publicly perform, publicly display, distribute, communicate, promote and otherwise use Your Content as reasonably necessary to operate, secure, improve, market and develop the Platform and its services.
Any separate commercial licensing, brand usage, creator monetisation arrangement or third-party exploitation of creator content will be governed by the applicable Terms, Creator & Monetisation Policy, competition rules or separate agreement. We will not interpret this Privacy Policy as granting GullyFame unlimited ownership of your original content.

9. PAYMENTS, KYC AND CREATOR MONETISATION
If you use tipping, creator payouts, competitions with monetary prizes, commerce or other paid features, we may process payment and KYC information necessary to provide the service, prevent fraud, comply with tax and financial obligations, verify eligibility and make lawful payouts.
Payment and KYC information may be processed by payment gateways, banks, KYC providers and other service providers acting on our behalf. We may retain financial/KYC records for the period required by applicable law, accounting, tax, fraud-prevention or dispute-resolution requirements.

10. COMPETITIONS, REWARDS AND INTEGRITY
Where the Platform operates competitions or rewards, we may process account, content, engagement, voting, judging, referral, payment and verification information to administer the competition, detect manipulation, verify eligibility, determine winners, make payouts and handle disputes.
We may use automated systems and human review to detect bots, purchased engagement, multiple-account abuse, coordinated or automated voting, fraudulent referrals and other manipulation. We may restrict, suspend, disqualify or withhold rewards where permitted under the applicable competition rules.

11. AI, DEEPFAKES AND SYNTHETIC CONTENT
GullyFame may process content and technical signals to identify or manage AI-generated, synthetically generated or materially manipulated content where required for safety, transparency, legal compliance or Platform integrity.
Users must comply with applicable requirements concerning disclosure, labelling or other treatment of synthetically generated information as detailed in the FAQs. Content that impersonates a real person, deceives users, facilitates fraud, or otherwise violates applicable law or Platform rules may be labelled, restricted or removed.
GullyFame may use automated detection, provenance or moderation technologies and may require additional disclosures or verification where appropriate. Specific AI-content rules will also be set out in the Community Guidelines and Terms of Use.
Any violation, will lead to immediate content deletion, temporary account suspension, or permanent termination, alongwith forfeiture of account rights. That upon receiving actual knowledge, court orders or government notices, the Platform reserves the right to remove or disable access to unlawful content within 3 hours, without prior notice. GullyFame is legally obligated to cooperate with law and enforcement (under Section 78 and 80 of IT Act) and may preserve and share user logs, Meta Data, or device information during criminal investigations.

12. SHARING AND DISCLOSURE
We may share personal data with: (a) hosting, cloud, analytics, moderation, customer-support, payment, KYC and security service providers acting on our behalf; (b) affiliates where permitted and necessary for operations; (c) business partners for features you choose to use, subject to applicable requirements; (d) advertising or measurement providers as permitted by law; and (e) law-enforcement, regulators, courts or government authorities where legally required or permitted.
We require appropriate contractual, technical or organisational safeguards from relevant processors/service providers where required. We do not sell personal data in the ordinary course of business.

13. DATA RETENTION
We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, for the operation and security of the Platform, and for applicable legal, tax, accounting, fraud-prevention, dispute-resolution and enforcement requirements.
Retention varies by category. Account data may be retained while an account is active and for a limited period thereafter; payment/KYC and tax records may be retained for periods required by law; security and fraud logs may be retained for as long as reasonably necessary to protect the Platform; and support or dispute records may be retained for a reasonable period to resolve and evidence the matter.
When retention is no longer necessary and no legal exception applies, we will delete or anonymise the relevant personal data.

14. DATA DELETION AND ACCOUNT CLOSURE
Where the Platform provides account deletion, you may initiate deletion through the account/settings process or by contacting us through the privacy contact below. Deletion may not immediately remove information that must be retained by law or is required for security, fraud prevention, financial records, disputes or legal claims.
Public content, competition records, transaction records or information already lawfully shared with third parties may be subject to separate deletion, retention or archival rules described in the relevant terms.

15. USER RIGHTS
Subject to applicable law, users may have rights to access information about processing, request correction or updating, request erasure where applicable, withdraw consent where consent is the basis, exercise nomination rights where applicable, and raise grievances with GullyFame and/or the competent authority as provided by law.
Requests should be made through the contact details below. We may need to verify identity before completing a request and may decline or limit a request where permitted by law.

16. DATA SECURITY
We implement reasonable and appropriate technical and organisational safeguards designed to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, loss, misuse and destruction. Measures may include encryption in transit and at rest where appropriate, access controls, authentication, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response and vendor due diligence.
No electronic system is completely secure. Users are responsible for protecting their passwords, devices and account credentials and should promptly report suspected unauthorised access.

17. DATA BREACHES AND INCIDENT RESPONSE
If a personal-data breach occurs, GullyFame will assess and respond in accordance with applicable law, including required notifications to affected users, authorities or other parties where legally required. We may take immediate measures such as account restrictions, credentials resets, content restrictions or other security controls to contain an incident.

18. CROSS-BORDER TRANSFERS
Where personal data is processed or transferred outside India, GullyFame will do so in accordance with applicable Indian Law, including any restrictions, safeguards or government requirements that apply to the relevant transfer or recipient.

19. GRIEVANCE OFFICER AND CONTACT
For privacy‑related queries, complaints, or requests, contact: Data Protection Officer / Privacy Officer Name: Email: Address:
GullyFame India will acknowledge and address grievances within timelines prescribed by applicable law and the applicable Grievance Redressal Policy. The final published policy should state the correct statutory timelines applicable to the relevant grievance category.

20. CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
We may update this Policy to reflect changes in law, technology, Platform Features or business practices. Where required, we will provide notice of material changes and obtain consent where legally necessary. The latest version will be made available through the Platform or other appropriate channel.

21. GOVERNING LAW
This Policy is intended to operate under the laws of India and applicable rules and regulations. Any dispute relating specifically to privacy will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the Platform's Terms of Use.

22. RELATED POLICIES
This Privacy Policy should be read together with the GullyFame India Terms of Use, Community Guidelines, Grievance Redressal Policy, Content Removal Policy, Creator & Monetisation Policy, Competition & Rewards Policy and Copyright / IP Policy, as applicable.
